name: portion-app
description: Portion – iOS & Android app built from the original Portion website (Capacitor)

scripts.android:add: npm run build && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.ios:add: npm run build && npx cap add ios
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
